description: Partner pack for Hyperliquid — on-chain perp DEX with its own L1, order-book matching, sub-second latency. Biases toward trading UIs, market-maker bots, and HyperEVM on-chain programmability.

defaults.headline: Build on Hyperliquid — on-chain perps at order-book latency
defaults.subheadline: Hyperliquid L1 + HyperEVM. Trading UIs, MM bots, perps-native products, and on-chain composability.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions Hyperliquid, HyperEVM, perpetual futures / perps DEX, on-chain order book, or a market-making bot targeting DEX-native perps.
firstSteps: For trading, use the Hyperliquid Python or TS SDK — WebSocket for order book + REST for order placement. Docs: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs.
For smart-contract flows, target HyperEVM (chainId 999 mainnet, 998 testnet) — it is a standard EVM sharing state with the core L1.
Signing uses the standard EVM ECDSA path but over EIP-712 typed-data structures specific to Hyperliquid — do NOT reuse raw viem `signMessage` helpers for orders.
gotchas: The matching layer runs on the L1 (not HyperEVM) — a smart contract on HyperEVM CANNOT place orders directly. Use the L1 API bridge.
Testnet has its own API hosts + chainId; running against mainnet by accident will route real funds. Always log the network at startup.
Rate limits are strict on REST: prefer WebSocket for live book, REST only for order submission + queries.
